_meta.about: Real champion kits for common bot-lane opponents (roadmap step 9). Abilities use the wiki's rank tables; ranks follow skill_start / skill_max (a model choice). Per-item stats copy the class profile named in items_like (config/threats.json), which is an estimate. Ultimates, shields, slows, roots and missed skillshots are not modeled; roots do not stop Kalista from attacking, so only stuns count as crowd control. Kits are never calibrated: they deal their real numbers.
_meta.fields: base/ad_ratio/bonus_ad_ratio/ap_ratio/cd: number or list by rank; base_mult multiplies the base and ratios (several hits); cc: seconds of stun per cast; first: first cast time; auto_procs: every (Nth auto), per_target_cd (seconds), after_ability (next auto after a cast).

Caitlyn.note: Headshot every 6th attack (5 stacks then the next): 60/80/100% AD by level (1/7/13) plus crit scaling. Traps and net headshots are not modeled.

Ezreal.note: Mystic Shot refunds 1.5 s of cooldown on hit (all shots assumed to hit). Essence Flux is assumed detonated right away by the next Mystic Shot.

Lux.note: Light Binding roots (Kalista can still attack, so no crowd control here). Illumination: the next auto after an ability deals 30-200 (+35% AP) magic damage.

Nautilus.note: Dredge Line stuns for 1 s. Riptide's three waves (first full, then 50% each) total 2x the listed damage. Staggering Blow: first auto on a target every 6 s deals 14-116 bonus physical and roots (no crowd control here).
